summary.en: It started when the idol Risa Purple was having a concert, but in fail, they kidnapped Ran as Risa Purple. After the confusion caused by the sprinkler system going off, two assailants attempted to kidnap Risa. Ran dressed in her Risa cosplay charged the stage and tried fighting but was tazed and carried off by mistake by the culprits. Realizing that they've kidnapped the wrong target, Takeyama and Ihara knock out Ran and take her to their illegal dump site in an attempt to bury her alive.
